title: Cannabis sativa cream for medicinal use
intro: Cannabis sativa cream is a topical herbal preparation made from cannabis plant extracts, typically containing cannabidiol (CBD) and other cannabinoids. It is used in herbalism to provide localized relief for conditions such as pain, inflammation, and skin irritation. The cream is applied directly to the skin to target specific areas of discomfort without causing systemic effects. It is often favored for its potential anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. This preparation is used in both traditional and modern herbal practices for its therapeutic benefits.
